parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
parameters.definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

parameters.name: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The ratio of vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to a plane surface of pure water, expressed in percent.

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Dew/Frost Point at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The dew/frost point temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Maximum Dry Bulb Temperature at 2 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Minimum Dry Bulb Temperature at 2 Meters

parameters.name: Surface Pressure
parameters.definition: The atmospheric pressure at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Wet Bulb Temperature at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The adiabatic saturation temperature which can be measured by a thermometer covered in a water-soaked cloth over which air is passed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Longwave Downward Irradiance
parameters.definition: The downward thermal infrared irradiance under all sky conditions reaching a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth. Also known as Horizontal Infrared Radiation Intensity from the Sky.

parameters.name: Wind Direction at 50 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of the wind direction at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Wind Direction at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of the wind direction at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Albedo
parameters.definition: The all sky rate of reflectivity of the earth's surface; the ratio of the solar energy reflected by the surface of the earth compared to the total solar energy incident reaching the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Diffuse Irradiance
parameters.definition: The diffuse (scattered from original direct path by molecules or particles) solar irradiance incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Direct Normal Irradiance
parameters.definition: The direct solar irradiance incident to a horizontal plane normal (perpendicular) to the direction of the sun's position under all sky conditions.

parameters.name: Cloud Amount
parameters.definition: The average percent of cloud amount during the temporal period.

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Downward Irradiance
parameters.definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Precipitable Water
parameters.definition: The total atmospheric water vapor contained in a vertical column of the atmosphere, sourced from CERES.

parameters.name: Precipitation Corrected
parameters.definition: The average MERRA-2 bias corrected total precipitation at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Profile Soil Wetness
parameters.definition: The amount of water and water vapor present in the soil. Profile indicates the layer from the surface down to the bedrock. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature
parameters.definition: The average temperature at the earth's surface.

parameters.name: Wind Direction at 10 Meters
parameters.definition: The average of the wind direction at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: All Sky Surface Total PAR
parameters.definition: The total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

parameters.name: Specific Humidity at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at 2 meters.

parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Range
parameters.definition: The difference between the minimum and maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Dry Bulb Temperature Range at 2 Meters

parameters.name: All Sky Insolation Clearness Index
parameters.definition: A fraction representing clearness of the atmosphere; the all sky insolation that is transmitted through the atmosphere to strike the surface of the earth divided by the average of top of the atmosphere total solar irradiance incident.

parameters.name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
parameters.definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.
keywords: Clear Sky Total Horizontal Solar Radiation

parameters.name: Root Zone Soil Wetness
parameters.definition: The amount of water and water vapor available to plants in the root zone, generally considered to be the upper 1 m of soil, expressed as the proportion of water present in a given amount of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

parameters.name: Surface Soil Wetness
parameters.definition: The amount of water and water vapor present in the soil. Top indicates the upper 5 cm of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.

parameters.name: Cooling Degree Days Above 0 C
parameters.definition: The daily accumulation of degrees above a 0-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is above the threshold.

parameters.name: Cooling Degree Days Above 18.3 C
parameters.definition: The daily accumulation of degrees above an 18.3-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is above the threshold.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum hourly earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum hourly earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Eastward Wind at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The estimate of the eastward wind average speed for winds blowing 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Evaporation Land
parameters.definition: The evaporation over land at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Evapotranspiration Energy Flux
parameters.definition: The evapotranspiration energy flux at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Frost Days
parameters.definition: A frost day occurs when the 2m temperature cools to the dew point temperature and both are less than 0 C or 32 F.

parameters.name: Heating Degree Days Below 0 C
parameters.definition: The daily accumulation of degrees below a 0-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is below the threshold.

parameters.name: Heating Degree Days Below 18.3 C
parameters.definition: The daily accumulation of degrees below an 18.3-degree-Celsius threshold when the daily mean temperature is below the threshold.

parameters.name: Midday Insolation Incident
parameters.definition: The total amount of solar irradiance (direct plus diffuse) incident on a horizontal plane at the earth's surface during the solar noon hour midday period.

parameters.name: Northward Wind at 2 Meters
parameters.definition: The estimate of the northward wind average speed for winds blowing 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Snow Depth
parameters.definition: The snow depth on land at surface of the earth.

parameters.definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 2; 0.0988 to 0.294 m depth.

parameters.name: Soil Temperatures Layer 3
parameters.definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 3; 0.294 to 0.6799 m depth.

parameters.name: Soil Temperatures Layer 4
parameters.definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 4; 0.6799 to 1.4425 m depth.

parameters.name: Soil Temperatures Layer 5
parameters.definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 5; 1.4425 to 2.949 m depth.

parameters.name: Soil Temperatures Layer 6
parameters.definition: The estimate of soil temperatures at layer 6; 2.949 to 10.0 m depth.

parameters.name: Solar Zenith Angle
parameters.definition: The angle between the geodetic zenith vector and a vector from the earth point to the sun integrated over the period.

parameters.name: Clear Sky Surface Shortwave Upward Irradiance Standard Deviation
parameters.definition: The standard deviation of upward shortwave irradiance under clearsky conditions.

parameters.name: Clear Sky Surface Total PAR Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

parameters.name: Clear Sky Surface Total PAR Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

parameters.name: Clear Sky Surface Total PAR Standard Deviation
parameters.definition: The standard deviation of total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under clear sky conditions.

parameters.name: Cloud Amount at Daytime
parameters.definition: The average percent of cloud amount during daylight.

parameters.name: Cloud Amount at Nighttime
parameters.definition: The average percent of cloud amount during nighttime.

parameters.name: Cloud Optical Visible Depth
parameters.definition: The vertical optical thickness between the top and bottom of a cloud.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Adjusted
parameters.definition: The adjusted average temperature at the earth's surface. Adjusted refers to CERES source parameter.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily maximum earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily minimum earth skin temperature in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Earth Skin Temperature Range
parameters.definition: The minimum and maximum hourly earth skin temperature range in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Eastward Wind at 50 Meters
parameters.definition: The estimate of the eastward wind average speed for winds blowing 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Ice Covered Fraction
parameters.definition: The fraction of ocean covered by sea ice.

parameters.name: Land Snowcover Fraction
parameters.definition: The fraction of land covered by snow.

parameters.name: Midday Insolation Incident Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum total amount of solar irradiance (direct plus diffuse) incident on a horizontal plane at the earth's surface during the solar noon hour midday period.

parameters.name: Midday Insolation Incident Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum total amount of solar irradiance (direct plus diffuse) incident on a horizontal plane at the earth's surface during the solar noon hour midday period.

parameters.name: Midday Insolation Incident Standard Deviation
parameters.definition: The standard deviation of the total amount of solar irradiance (direct plus diffuse) incident on a horizontal plane at the earth's surface during the solar noon hour midday period.

parameters.name: Northward Wind at 50 Meters
parameters.definition: The estimate of the northward wind average speed for winds blowing 50 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Peak Sun Hour
parameters.definition: The average intensity of solar irradiance that reaches the surface.

parameters.name: Planetary Boundary Layer Top Pressure
parameters.definition: The pressure at the top of the planet boundary layer.

parameters.name: Precipitation Corrected Sum
parameters.definition: The accumulated MERRA-2 bias corrected total precipitation at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Sea Level Pressure
parameters.definition: The sea level pressure at the surface of the earth.
keywords: Barometric Pressure Reduced to Sea Level

parameters.name: Snow Precipitation
parameters.definition: The snow precipitation at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Snow Precipitation Land
parameters.definition: The snow precipitation only over land at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Snow Precipitation Land Sum
parameters.definition: The accumulated snow precipitation over land at the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Specific Humidity at 10 Meters
parameters.definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at 10 meters.

parameters.name: Surface Air Density
parameters.definition: The air density at surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Surface Albedo Adjusted
parameters.definition: The ratio of the solar energy reflected by the surface of the earth compared to the total solar energy incident reaching the surface of the earth. Adjusted refers to CERES source parameter.

parameters.name: Surface Roughness
parameters.definition: The height above the displacement plane at which the mean wind becomes zero when extrapolating the logarithmic wind speed profile downward through the surface layer.

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters
parameters.definition: The air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Maximum Dry Bulb Temperature at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily maximum air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Mean Daily Maximum Temperature at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Minimum Dry Bulb Temperature at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily minimum air (dry bulb) temperature at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Mean Daily Minimum Temperature at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 10 Meters Range
parameters.definition: The minimum and maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature range at 10 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
keywords: Dry Bulb Temperature Range at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily maximum air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the daily minimum air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Direct Normal Radiation Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane where oriented to the sun's position at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Direct Normal Radiation Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane where oriented to the sun's position at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Direct Normal Radiation Standard Deviation
parameters.definition: The standard deviation of total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane where oriented to the sun's position at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Downward Irradiance Maximum
parameters.definition: The maximum total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Downward Irradiance Minimum
parameters.definition: The minimum total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Top-Of-Atmosphere Shortwave Downward Irradiance Standard Deviation
parameters.definition: The standard deviation of total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the top of the atmosphere (extraterrestrial radiation).

parameters.name: Total Column Ozone
parameters.definition: The total amount of ozone in a column extending vertically from the earth's surface to the top of the atmosphere.

parameters.name: Total Column Precipitable Water
parameters.definition: The total atmospheric water vapor contained in a vertical column of unit cross-sectional area extending from the surface to the top of the atmosphere, sourced from the GMAO.

parameters.name: Tropopause Pressure based on blended estimate.
parameters.definition: The tropopause pressure based on the blended estimate.

parameters.name: Tropopause Specific Humidity using blended TROPP estimate.
parameters.definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at the tropopause pressure given by TROPPB.

parameters.name: Tropopause Temperature using blended TROPP estimate.
parameters.definition: The air (dry bulb) temperature at the tropopause pressure given by TROPPB.

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the maximum daily wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Maximum Wind Speed at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the minimum daily wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Minimum Wind Speed at 10 Meters

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the maximum daily wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Maximum Wind Speed at 2 Meters

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the minimum daily wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Minimum Wind Speed at 2 Meters

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters Maximum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the maximum daily wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Maximum Wind Speed at 50 Meters

parameters.name: Wind Speed at 50 Meters Minimum Average
parameters.definition: The average of the minimum daily wind speed at 50 meters above the surface of the earth.
keywords: Mean Minimum Wind Speed at 50 Meters

parameters.name: Zero Plane Displacement Height
parameters.definition: The height at which the mean velocity is zero due to large obstacles such as buildings/canopy.
